title: Successful validation included source-access error annotations
detail: The branch validation run 39602172050 completed successfully, including the full Python suite, replay/build, strict source-row audit, phone/desktop/no-JavaScript and WCAG A/AA browser checks. Its annotations endpoint also reports four failure-level Hotspawn errors (HTTP 403 twice and lobby/API disagreement twice). A separate same-branch read-only live audit completed successfully at 12:47Z with the Hotspawn lobby and CS2 page cross-check and 19 current non-past fixtures. The annotation context is not available, so this audit records the discrepancy without attributing those errors to production or dismissing them.
